ground.label: Background
ground.note: The colour of the bar. Pick the one your site header is not on, so the two read as two things.

brand.label: Brand colour
brand.note: Your main brand colour, with the text in the colour that reads on it. The usual choice above a plain header.

deep.label: Dark
deep.note: The site's dark ground. Quieter than the brand colour, and the right choice above a brand-colour header.
